name: Claude Code setup
description: Persists the whole ~/.claude directory and ~/.claude.json (credentials, sessions, memory, OAuth account, trust settings) across rebuilds, on top of the official claude-code feature for the CLI itself. Seeds a default permission policy on first use that requires approval for anything reaching outside the container (git push/fetch/clone, ssh/scp, curl/wget, gh, package installs, WebFetch) while keeping local file edits and read-only exploration frictionless, and forces a real approval prompt on edits to ~/.claude/settings.json itself via a path-scoped permissions.ask rule.
